economy.summary: Voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act in July 2025, calling it a direct response to what Americans demanded, including lower costs and greater opportunity, and citing its elimination of taxes on tips and overtime through 2028.
economy.short: Voted for 2025 budget law, citing lower costs, greater opportunity.

taxes.summary: Voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, which he said makes the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act tax relief permanent, prevents a large tax increase, eliminates taxes on tips and overtime, and creates a $6,000 senior deduction.
taxes.short: Voted to make 2017 tax cuts permanent, exempt tips, overtime.

abortion.summary: Cosponsored and voted for the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act (H.R. 21), which passed the House in January 2025, and has voted against federal funding of abortion.
abortion.short: Cosponsored Born-Alive Act; voted against federal abortion funding.

education.summary: Spoke on the House floor in favor of the Educational Choice for Children Act (H.R. 833), a federal tax credit for donations to K-12 scholarship funds, and supports expanding school choice including 529 education savings plans.
education.short: Supports school choice; backed federal tax-credit scholarship bill.

healthcare.summary: Said the One Big Beautiful Bill Act strengthens Medicaid for those it was intended to support, and supports its work requirements for able-bodied adults without dependents and removal of ineligible enrollees.
healthcare.short: Supports Medicaid work requirements; says 2025 law strengthens Medicaid.

energy.summary: Spoke in support of the Protecting American Energy Production Act, which would bar a presidential moratorium on hydraulic fracturing without congressional approval, saying Pennsylvania does fracking best and cleanest, and supports pipelines and natural gas development.
energy.short: Supports fracking, pipelines; opposes presidential fracking moratorium.

guns.summary: Cosponsored the Constitutional Concealed Carry Reciprocity Act (H.R. 38), providing nationwide reciprocity for concealed carry permit holders across state lines, saying constitutional rights do not end at a state border.
guns.short: Cosponsored nationwide concealed carry reciprocity for permit holders.

economy.summary: Proposes lowering the cost of living and raising wages, including funding trade schools, supporting workers' right to unionize, defending prevailing wage protections, and creating a first-time homebuyer credit and a starter home construction credit.
economy.short: Proposes lowering costs, raising wages; supports unions, housing credits.

taxes.summary: Supports bipartisan measures requiring Congress to pass federal budgets on schedule and maintain government operations.
taxes.short: Supports Congress passing federal budgets on schedule.

education.summary: Supports funding trade schools and making education more accessible for working adults as part of her jobs plan.
education.short: Supports funding trade schools, education access for working adults.

healthcare.summary: Proposes reversing the 2025 congressional health care cuts, banning prior authorization by insurance companies, capping insurance executive compensation from premiums, and addressing industry consolidation.
healthcare.short: Proposes reversing 2025 health cuts, banning prior authorization.
